words.enDefinition: a database representing data as relations, commonly displayed as rows and columns in tables

examples.en: The class used a relational database to store separate tables for classrooms, bookings and the people making reservations.
examples.zh: 我们班用「关系数据库」分别存放教室、预订记录以及预订人信息。

examples.en: We designed a relational database so every loan could point to the existing record for its book.
examples.zh: 我们设计了一个「关系数据库」，使每条借阅记录都能指向所借图书的现有记录。

collocations: store records in a relational database

words.enDefinition: software that creates and manages relational databases and processes queries and changes to their data

examples.en: Our course used a relational database management system to check the links between products and orders.
examples.zh: 课程用「关系数据库管理系统」检查产品与订单之间的关联。

examples.en: The tutor compared how each relational database management system handled an attempt to add the same key twice.
examples.zh: 导师比较了各「关系数据库管理系统」遇到两次添加同一个键时的处理方式。

collocations: use a relational database management system
choose a relational database management system
install a relational database management system

words.enDefinition: the formal structure of a database, specifying how data and database objects are organised

examples.en: The database schema diagram showed which table stored the names of the supervisors for each room.
examples.zh: 「数据库模式」图显示了哪个表存放各房间负责人的姓名。

examples.en: We reviewed the database schema after changing the tables used to record attendance at weekly workshops.
examples.zh: 更换记录每周工作坊出勤情况的表后，我们复查了「数据库模式」。

words.enDefinition: an object name written with its containing schema to identify which object is meant

examples.en: Our PostgreSQL example used a schema-qualified name because two schemas contained tables with the same name.
examples.zh: PostgreSQL 示例里有两个模式都包含同名表，我们使用了「带模式限定的名称」。

examples.en: The tutor used a schema-qualified name to show which copy of the sample table was being read.
examples.zh: 导师用「带模式限定的名称」准确指明正在读取哪一份示例表。

collocations: refer to a table by its schema-qualified name

words.enDefinition: the specification of a table's name, columns and relevant constraints

examples.en: The table definition allowed international phone numbers because the contact information was stored as text.
examples.zh: 「表定义」允许录入国际电话号码，因为联系信息以文本形式存储。

examples.en: We reviewed the table definition before choosing where to store the date each workshop had been completed.
examples.zh: 选定在哪里存储各场工作坊的完成日期前，我们检查了「表定义」。

words.enDefinition: the specification of a column's name, data type and any column settings included in the table declaration

examples.en: The column definition made the assignment title required while a separately defined completion date could remain null.
examples.zh: 「列定义」规定作业标题必须填写，而另行定义的完成日期可以为空。

examples.en: We changed the column definition to let the example store marks with a decimal portion.
examples.zh: 我们修改「列定义」，以便示例能存储带小数的成绩。

collocations: include a default in a column definition

words.enDefinition: a minimal set of columns whose values uniquely identify each row of a relation

examples.en: The exercise used the serial number as a candidate key because no two items shared the same number.
examples.zh: 练习把序列号用作「候选键」，因为没有两件物品的序列号相同。

examples.en: We checked whether the student identifier alone was a candidate key for the table containing course registrations.
examples.zh: 我们核查在存放选课登记的表里，仅靠学生标识符能否构成「候选键」。

collocations: test the minimality of a candidate key

words.enDefinition: the selected column or set of columns used to identify each row uniquely, with null values disallowed

examples.en: The primary key let our query refer to the correct loan even when two people had identical names.
examples.zh: 即使两个人同名，「主键」也让查询指向正确的借阅记录。

examples.en: We assigned each workshop a numeric primary key so changing its title would leave its identity unchanged.
examples.zh: 我们给每场工作坊分配一个数字「主键」，这样标题变了也不影响它的标识。

words.enDefinition: a key made up of more than one column

examples.en: The composite key combined a schedule identifier with a seat number to identify each available place.
examples.zh: 「复合键」将日程标识符与座位号组合，用于标识每个可用座位。

examples.en: We explained why dropping either column from the composite key could make two registrations indistinguishable.
examples.zh: 我们解释了为何从「复合键」中删掉任意一列，都可能使两条登记记录无法区分。

collocations: use columns in a composite key

words.enDefinition: an introduced identifier whose value has no independent business meaning

examples.en: The database assigned a surrogate key to each book record when it imported the catalogue.
examples.zh: 数据库导入目录时，给每条图书记录分配了一个「代理键」。

examples.en: We kept the public ticket number separate from the surrogate key used internally to identify each sale.
examples.zh: 我们将公开的票号与内部用于识别每笔交易的「代理键」分开。

words.enDefinition: an existing meaningful attribute or combination of attributes used to identify rows uniquely

examples.en: The tutor used a full vehicle registration code as the natural key in the model records.
examples.zh: 导师在示例记录中用完整车辆登记代码作为「自然键」。

examples.en: We tested whether the natural key would still identify each record after the naming convention changed.
examples.zh: 我们检验命名规则改变后，「自然键」是否仍能标识每条记录。

collocations: use an existing attribute as a natural key

words.enDefinition: a candidate key that was not selected as the primary key

examples.en: In the exercise, the catalogue number became an alternate key after we chose an internal identifier as primary.
examples.zh: 练习中，我们选用内部标识符作主键后，目录编号成了「备选键」。

examples.en: We used an alternate key to find a product by its stable manufacturer code during the demonstration.
examples.zh: 演示时，我们用「备选键」按产品固定的厂商编码查找产品。

collocations: look up a row by an alternate key

words.enDefinition: a column or set of columns constrained to match values of a referenced key, subject to any null rules

examples.en: The foreign key linked each booking to a classroom that was already listed in the room table.
examples.zh: 「外键」把每条预订记录关联到教室表中已经列出的一个教室。

examples.en: We added a foreign key so a sample order could only refer to a recorded product.
examples.zh: 我们添加了「外键」，使练习中的订单只能指向已记录的产品。

collocations: reference another table with a foreign key

words.enDefinition: the table containing the target columns of a foreign key, possibly the same table as the referencing table

examples.en: We checked the referenced table to see whether the classroom identifier on the booking was valid.
examples.zh: 我们核查「被引用表」，确认预订记录上的教室标识符是否有效。

examples.en: The diagram drew a line from each foreign key to the corresponding key in its referenced table.
examples.zh: 图中从每个外键画一条线，连到「被引用表」里对应的键。

collocations: look up a value in the referenced table
delete a row from the referenced table

words.enDefinition: the table containing a foreign key that points to a target key

examples.en: The referencing table stored each reservation alongside the identifier of the instructor responsible for it.
examples.zh: 「引用表」存放各条预订记录，并记录负责它的讲师标识符。

examples.en: We found duplicate room identifiers in the referencing table because several bookings used the same room.
examples.zh: 有几条预订使用同一教室，所以我们在「引用表」里发现重复出现的教室标识符。

collocations: insert rows into the referencing table
find dependent rows in the referencing table

words.enDefinition: consistency of relationships so stored references point to valid records according to the defined foreign key rules

examples.en: Our database maintained referential integrity by rejecting a new loan for a book absent from the catalogue.
examples.zh: 数据库通过拒绝为目录中不存在的书新增借阅记录，维护了「引用完整性」。

examples.en: The tutor checked referential integrity after loading the sample classes and the associated registration records.
examples.zh: 加载示例课程及其选课记录后，导师检查了「引用完整性」。

words.enDefinition: a rule requiring that values or combinations of values are not duplicated where the database treats them as equal

examples.en: We added a unique constraint on the catalogue code so that the same identifier could not appear twice.
examples.zh: 我们给目录编号加了「唯一约束」，使同一标识符不能出现两次。

examples.en: The class tested how the unique constraint behaved when a missing locker number appeared in several sample rows.
examples.zh: 同学们测试了多个样本行的储物柜编号为空时，「唯一约束」会如何处理。

words.enDefinition: a constraint evaluating a condition on inserted or updated row values, normally accepting true or unknown in SQL

examples.en: The check constraint rejected negative durations when we tried adding them to the practice table of events.
examples.zh: 我们向活动练习表添加负数时长时，「检查约束」拒绝了这些值。

examples.en: We combined a check constraint on the maximum score with a separate requirement that the score be present.
examples.zh: 我们通过「检查约束」限制成绩的上限，并另行规定成绩不能为空。

words.enDefinition: a rule prohibiting null values in a column

examples.en: The not-null constraint stopped the practice database from saving a workshop booking without an assigned date.
examples.zh: 「非空约束」使练习数据库无法保存未指定日期的工作坊预订。

examples.en: We added a not-null constraint after confirming that every existing catalogue entry had a recorded title.
examples.zh: 确认现有每条目录记录都存有标题后，我们加了「非空约束」。

words.enDefinition: an expression used to calculate a column's value when a new row does not provide one

examples.en: The default expression recorded today's date whenever our example added a loan without an explicit date.
examples.zh: 示例新增未明确提供日期的借阅记录时，「默认表达式」会记录当天日期。

examples.en: We changed the default expression so new workshop records started with an empty notes field.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「默认表达式」，让新增工作坊记录的备注字段默认为空。

words.enDefinition: a column whose missing insert values are automatically provided by an associated sequence under SQL identity rules

examples.en: The identity column automatically assigned a number when the tutor inserted a new sample product into the table.
examples.zh: 导师向表中插入一件示例产品时，「标识列」自动分配了一个编号。

examples.en: We used an identity column for the loan number and added a primary key to enforce its uniqueness.
examples.zh: 我们用「标识列」生成借阅编号，再加主键来保证唯一性。

collocations: insert a row with an identity column
use an identity column as a primary key

words.enDefinition: a column whose value is calculated by the database from an expression rather than stored as independently supplied input

examples.en: The generated column displayed the area of each rectangle using the lengths stored in the same row.
examples.zh: 「生成列」用同一行存储的边长计算并显示每个矩形的面积。

examples.en: We changed a width value and watched the generated column show the new result without entering it ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们改了宽度值，看到「生成列」自动显示新结果，不需要自己录入。

collocations: compute the value of a generated column

words.enDefinition: a case in which a proposed or stored value fails to satisfy a defined database rule

examples.en: A constraint violation explained why the example could not add another product with that catalogue number.
examples.zh: 因为「违反约束」，示例无法再添加一件目录编号相同的产品。

examples.en: We inspected the reported constraint violation and found that the booking referred to a nonexistent room.
examples.zh: 我们检查报告的「违反约束」错误后发现，这条预订指向不存在的教室。

collocations: reject a row for a constraint violation

words.enDefinition: a foreign key rule specifying what happens to dependent references when the target row changes or is deleted

examples.en: The diagram identified the referential action that would run when a sample parent record was removed.
examples.zh: 图中标明了删除示例父记录时会触发的「引用操作」。

examples.en: We compared each referential action before choosing what should happen to notes attached to a deleted workshop.
examples.zh: 我们先比较各种「引用操作」，再决定工作坊被删除后如何处理关联备注。

words.enDefinition: a foreign key action in which deleting a referenced row automatically deletes dependent rows that refer to it

examples.en: A cascading delete removed the sample worksheet's temporary rows when the worksheet record itself was deleted.
examples.zh: 删除示例练习表的记录时，「级联删除」移除了它所关联的临时行。

examples.en: The classroom model showed how a cascading delete affected the child records linked to that entry.
examples.zh: 课堂模型演示了「级联删除」如何删除链接到该条目的子记录。

collocations: inspect rows affected by a cascading delete

words.enDefinition: a foreign key action that copies changes in referenced key values into dependent foreign key values

examples.en: The cascading update changed related room identifiers after we corrected the key in the practice table.
examples.zh: 我们纠正练习表中的键后，「级联更新」更改了相关的教室标识符。

examples.en: We verified that the cascading update preserved both reservations when the original workshop identifier was corrected.
examples.zh: 我们验证了原工作坊标识符被更正后，「级联更新」保留了两条预订记录。

collocations: apply a cascading update to dependent rows

words.enDefinition: a deferrable constraint whose current check is postponed until a later point in the transaction

examples.en: The temporary inconsistency was permitted under a deferred constraint because both reference changes completed before the transaction committed.
examples.zh: 「延迟检查的约束」允许中途暂时不一致，因为两处引用变更都在事务提交前完成了。

examples.en: We tested whether the deferred constraint would reject the final state once the classroom transaction tried to commit.
examples.zh: 我们测试课堂事务尝试提交时，「延迟检查的约束」会不会拒绝最终状态。

collocations: check a deferred constraint at commit
switch a deferred constraint to immediate mode

words.enDefinition: an association that allows at most one counterpart for each record on either side

examples.en: We represented a one-to-one relationship between a locker and the one student currently assigned to it.
examples.zh: 我们用「一对一关系」表示储物柜与当前获分配该柜的一名学生之间的关联。

examples.en: The example used a one-to-one relationship so no two case records pointed to the same optional detail row.
examples.zh: 示例使用「一对一关系」，使两条案例记录不会同时指向同一个可选明细行。

words.enDefinition: an association in which one record on the single side may correspond to many records on the other side

examples.en: A one-to-many relationship connected one department with the multiple workshops shown in the course listing.
examples.zh: 「一对多关系」把一个院系和课程清单所列的多场工作坊联系起来。

examples.en: We drew a one-to-many relationship from the book table to the records of its separate borrowing events.
examples.zh: 我们画了「一对多关系」，把图书表和同一本书的多次借阅记录关联起来。

words.enDefinition: an association allowing several records on either side to be linked with several records on the other

examples.en: The many-to-many relationship let students register for several clubs and each club accept multiple students.
examples.zh: 「多对多关系」允许学生加入多个社团，也允许每个社团接收多个学生。

examples.en: We used a separate table to represent the many-to-many relationship between articles and their topic labels.
examples.zh: 我们用一个独立表表示文章与主题标签之间的「多对多关系」。

collocations: resolve a many-to-many relationship with an intermediate table

words.enDefinition: a table holding pairs of keys to represent links between records in a many-to-many relationship

examples.en: The junction table stored a student identifier and a club identifier for each membership recorded in the exercise.
examples.zh: 对练习记录的每次入会，「关联表」保存一个学生标识符和一个社团标识符。

examples.en: We put the enrolment date in the junction table because the date belonged to a specific registration.
examples.zh: 我们把报名日期放在「关联表」里，因为日期对应某一次具体的报名。

collocations: model a relationship with a junction table

words.enDefinition: a diagram showing the types of entities in a data model and the relationships between them

examples.en: The entity relationship diagram showed how borrowers, books and their loans would fit together in the database.
examples.zh: 「实体关系图」显示了借阅人、图书和借阅记录在数据库里的关联方式。

examples.en: We revised the entity relationship diagram after learning that each course could have several instructors.
examples.zh: 得知每门课程可以有多名教师后，我们修改了「实体关系图」。

words.enDefinition: a set of attributes whose combined values uniquely identify a row, whether or not all of them are needed

examples.en: The tutor called the room identifier and name a superkey because the identifier alone already distinguished each row.
examples.zh: 因为单靠房间标识符就能区分各行，导师把标识符和名称的组合称为「超键」。

examples.en: We tested whether the chosen attributes formed a superkey before checking if any of them could be removed.
examples.zh: 我们先检验选出的属性能否组成「超键」，再检查是否可移除其中某些属性。

collocations: check whether an attribute set forms a superkey
distinguish a superkey from a candidate key

words.enDefinition: a rule that rows with the same values for one set of attributes must also agree on another set

examples.en: The functional dependency meant that the same product code always determined the same product name in the model.
examples.zh: 「函数依赖」表示在这个模型里，同一个产品编码总能确定同一个产品名称。

examples.en: We checked whether a proposed functional dependency represented a business rule or only a coincidence in the sample.
examples.zh: 我们核查了一项拟定的「函数依赖」，判断它代表业务规则，还是样本中碰巧存在的关系。

words.enDefinition: a functional dependency in which an attribute depends on a proper subset of the stated determinant

examples.en: The partial dependency existed because the instructor's name depended on the instructor identifier alone within the composite key.
examples.zh: 教师姓名只依赖复合键中的教师标识符，因此存在「部分函数依赖」。

examples.en: We removed the partial dependency by putting course descriptions in a table keyed by course identifier.
examples.zh: 我们把课程描述放进以课程标识符为键的表，消除了「部分函数依赖」。

collocations: a partial dependency on a composite key

words.enDefinition: an indirect functional dependency in which one determinant reaches an attribute through an intermediate set of attributes

examples.en: The tutor illustrated a transitive dependency with a room code determining a building code and then its address.
examples.zh: 导师用房间编号确定楼宇编号、楼宇编号再确定地址的例子说明「传递函数依赖」。

examples.en: We removed the transitive dependency by recording the building address only in the table listing buildings.
examples.zh: 我们只在楼宇清单表里记录楼宇地址，从而消除了「传递函数依赖」。

words.enDefinition: organising relational tables using dependency rules to reduce unnecessary repetition and prevent common modification anomalies

examples.en: The example used database normalization to keep each instructor's contact details in just one table.
examples.zh: 示例采用「数据库规范化」，使每位教师的联系信息只保存在一张表里。

examples.en: We discussed which inconsistencies database normalization could prevent if the course titles changed during the term.
examples.zh: 我们讨论了在学期内更改课程标题时，「数据库规范化」能防止哪些不一致。

collocations: explain the purpose of database normalization

words.enDefinition: a relational design form that gives each attribute a single value from its domain in each row

examples.en: The tutor moved the repeating list of phone numbers into separate rows to illustrate first normal form.
examples.zh: 导师把重复出现的电话号码列表拆成若干行，用于演示「第一范式」。

examples.en: Our table design satisfied first normal form after we separated the individual workshop dates into their own rows.
examples.zh: 把各场工作坊的日期拆到独立的行后，我们的表设计符合「第一范式」。

collocations: convert a relation to first normal form
check a table for first normal form

words.enDefinition: first normal form with every attribute outside all candidate keys fully dependent on each candidate key

examples.en: The tutor checked second normal form after spotting a product name determined by just part of the key.
examples.zh: 导师发现产品名只由键的一部分确定，于是检查设计是否符合「第二范式」。

examples.en: We separated the course title from the registrations table to bring the classroom design into second normal form.
examples.zh: 我们把课程标题与登记表分开，使课堂设计达到「第二范式」。

collocations: move a relation into second normal form
identify a violation of second normal form

words.enDefinition: a normal form allowing a nontrivial dependency only when its determinant is a superkey or its dependent attribute is part of a candidate key

examples.en: The tutor used third normal form to explain why storing the building address in each booking caused redundancy.
examples.zh: 导师用「第三范式」说明为何在每条预订里保存楼宇地址会造成冗余。

examples.en: We checked each proposed table for third normal form using the dependencies recorded beside the class diagram.
examples.zh: 我们用课堂图旁列出的依赖，检查各拟定表是否符合「第三范式」。

collocations: decompose a relation into third normal form
check dependencies against third normal form

words.enDefinition: a normal form requiring the determinant of every nontrivial functional dependency to be a superkey

examples.en: The instructor tested Boyce-Codd normal form by looking for any nontrivial dependency whose determinant was not a superkey.
examples.zh: 导师检查是否存在决定因素并非超键的非平凡依赖，以判断是否符合「博伊斯科德范式」。

examples.en: We discussed whether adopting Boyce-Codd normal form would make some original dependencies harder to enforce without joining tables.
examples.zh: 我们讨论采用「博伊斯科德范式」后，是否有些原依赖需要联接表才更容易核验。

collocations: decompose a relation into Boyce-Codd normal form

words.enDefinition: deliberately introducing some redundancy into a relational design to obtain another benefit, such as faster common queries

examples.en: The reporting system used denormalization to keep the frequently requested category name beside each summary record.
examples.zh: 报告系统采用「反规范化」，在各汇总记录旁保存经常要查的类别名称。

examples.en: We discussed who would update the repeated names after denormalization made the report easier to read.
examples.zh: 「反规范化」让报告更易读后，我们讨论了由谁负责更新重复保存的名称。

words.enDefinition: a decomposition in which joining the projected relations reconstructs every original relation instance satisfying the stated constraints, without spurious rows

examples.en: The tutor illustrated lossless decomposition by joining the projected tables in our sample instance.
examples.zh: 导师通过联接样本实例投影得到的表，演示了什么是「无损分解」。

examples.en: We checked whether the shared identifier was sufficient to guarantee lossless decomposition under the stated dependencies.
examples.zh: 我们核查在给定依赖下，共有的标识符是否足以保证「无损分解」。

words.enDefinition: an inconsistency that can arise when a single fact is stored in multiple places and updated in only some

examples.en: An update anomaly left two different street addresses for the same building after only one record was changed.
examples.zh: 只改动一条记录后，「更新异常」导致同一栋楼留下两个不同的街道地址。

examples.en: The exercise showed how splitting off the building table prevented an update anomaly when its address changed.
examples.zh: 练习展示了拆出楼宇表如何在地址变化时防止「更新异常」。

words.enDefinition: difficulty recording one fact because the existing design requires an unrelated fact to be present at insertion

examples.en: The insertion anomaly meant we could not list a new course until at least one student enrolled.
examples.zh: 「插入异常」导致我们至少要等一名学生选课，才能将新课程列入表中。

examples.en: We fixed the insertion anomaly by keeping courses and enrolments in separate tables for the assignment.
examples.zh: 我们在作业中把课程和选课信息存于不同的表，修复了「插入异常」。

words.enDefinition: loss of an independent fact when removing a row that also stores unrelated information

examples.en: A deletion anomaly erased the course title from the sample table when the last registration was removed.
examples.zh: 最后一条选课记录被移除时，「删除异常」让样本表里的课程标题也随之消失。

examples.en: We demonstrated a deletion anomaly by removing the only booking that still contained the classroom's address.
examples.zh: 我们通过删除唯一仍保存教室地址的预订记录，演示了「删除异常」。

words.enDefinition: a SQL statement that retrieves rows or computes values according to a query

examples.en: Our SELECT statement returned the dates of the workshops that still had enough seats for another team.
examples.zh: 这条「SELECT 查询语句」返回了还有足够空位接收另一组人的工作坊日期。

examples.en: We checked the SELECT statement against the expected result before submitting the class exercise on relational databases.
examples.zh: 提交关系数据库课堂练习前，我们对照预期结果检查了「SELECT 查询语句」。

words.enDefinition: the expressions after SELECT that determine the columns or values returned by a query

examples.en: The select list showed the title and publication year but left other catalogue fields outside the results.
examples.zh: 「查询选择列表」显示标题和出版年份，其他目录字段不在结果中。

examples.en: We added a calculated expression to the select list so that the report displayed the price per item.
examples.zh: 我们在「查询选择列表」里加入计算表达式，使报告显示每件商品的价格。

collocations: add a column to the select list
evaluate expressions in the select list

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause determining the tables, joins or other sources from which query rows are drawn

examples.en: The FROM clause referred to the table holding workshop dates and the table holding bookable rooms.
examples.zh: 「FROM 来源子句」引用了存储工作坊日期的表和存储可预订教室的表。

examples.en: We checked the FROM clause after the query pulled rows from a table containing archived events.
examples.zh: 查询从存放归档活动的表里取数后，我们检查了「FROM 来源子句」。

collocations: reference a table in the FROM clause
put a join in the FROM clause

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause retaining input rows for which a condition evaluates to true

examples.en: The WHERE clause selected only bookings for the first week of classes in the sample calendar.
examples.zh: 「WHERE 筛选子句」只选取示例日历上开学第一周的预订记录。

examples.en: We removed the WHERE clause temporarily in the classroom database to see which records the unfiltered query returned.
examples.zh: 我们在课堂数据库里暂时移除「WHERE 筛选子句」，查看未经筛选的查询会返回哪些记录。

collocations: filter rows with a WHERE clause
combine conditions in a WHERE clause

words.enDefinition: a logical condition evaluated to decide which rows a query retains

examples.en: The filter predicate required both a future date and at least one seat available for the workshop.
examples.zh: 「筛选谓词」要求工作坊日期尚未到来，同时至少还有一个空位。

examples.en: We moved the filter predicate into the example query after confirming how it treated missing dates.
examples.zh: 确认它如何处理缺失日期后，我们把「筛选谓词」移进示例查询。

words.enDefinition: a name given to an output column or expression within a query

examples.en: The column alias gave the calculated average a name that made sense on the printed report.
examples.zh: 「列别名」为计算得到的平均值指定了一个在纸质报告上容易理解的名称。

examples.en: We added a column alias so readers could tell the registration date from the event date.
examples.zh: 我们加了「列别名」，让读者把报名日期和活动日期区分开。

collocations: display a result under a column alias

words.enDefinition: a name assigned in a query to a table reference for use within that query

examples.en: We assigned a table alias to each copy of the same table in our classroom join.
examples.zh: 在课堂联接查询里，同一张表的每处引用都被赋予一个「表别名」。

examples.en: The table alias made it clear which department record supplied the supervisor's name in the result.
examples.zh: 「表别名」明确了结果里的主管姓名来自哪条部门记录。

collocations: refer to a table by a table alias
qualify a column with a table alias

words.enDefinition: a column reference naming its table or table alias along with the column

examples.en: A qualified column reference resolved the ambiguity between two columns both labelled title in the source tables.
examples.zh: 两个源表各有一列叫 title，「带表限定的列引用」消除了歧义。

examples.en: We used a qualified column reference to specify which of the joined tables supplied the recorded date.
examples.zh: 我们使用「带表限定的列引用」，说明记录日期来自联接的哪张表。

collocations: check the prefix of a qualified column reference

words.enDefinition: the rows returned by a query, including any duplicate rows allowed by the query

examples.en: The result set contained one row for each book loan that met the date and location conditions.
examples.zh: 符合日期和地点条件的每条借阅记录，在「结果集」里各占一行。

examples.en: We counted the rows in the result set before adding the query output to our worksheet.
examples.zh: 把查询输出加入练习表之前，我们数了「结果集」的行数。

words.enDefinition: the rows remaining when duplicate combinations of selected values are removed from a query result

examples.en: We selected distinct rows to produce one entry per room and date combination in the timetable.
examples.zh: 我们选择「去重后的行」，使日程表中每种房间与日期组合只有一条记录。

examples.en: The example counted distinct rows after selecting the two location fields needed for the exercise.
examples.zh: 示例选出练习所需的两个地点字段后，统计了「去重后的行」。

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause specifying how rows of a query result should be sorted

examples.en: The ORDER BY clause placed the most recent additions first in the sample list of borrowed books.
examples.zh: 「ORDER BY 排序子句」把借书示例列表中最近添加的记录排在前面。

examples.en: We added an explicit ORDER BY clause before comparing the order of results across two runs.
examples.zh: 比较两次查询的结果顺序之前，我们先加了明确的「ORDER BY 排序子句」。

collocations: sort results with an ORDER BY clause
list multiple expressions in an ORDER BY clause

words.enDefinition: a secondary sorting column used to order rows whose earlier sort values are equal

examples.en: We added a tie-breaker column to show events sharing a start time in a predictable order.
examples.zh: 我们增加「用于打破并列的列」，使两个同一时间开始的活动每次都按可预测的顺序显示。

examples.en: The tie-breaker column used each catalogue number to resolve entries with identical publication years in the result.
examples.zh: 查询结果中的出版年份相同时，「用于打破并列的列」按目录编号决定顺序。

words.enDefinition: a SQL clause in some dialects that caps the number of rows returned

examples.en: The LIMIT clause returned the five most recent entries after the query sorted the sample reading dates.
examples.zh: 查询对示例读数日期排序后，「LIMIT 限行子句」使其只返回最近五条记录。

examples.en: We removed the LIMIT clause so the class could compare all qualifying readings in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们移除了「LIMIT 限行子句」，让同学能比较练习中所有符合条件的读数。

collocations: restrict output with a LIMIT clause
use a LIMIT clause with a deterministic ORDER BY

words.enDefinition: a SQL clause specifying how many leading rows to skip before returning results

examples.en: The OFFSET clause skipped the first ten records from the sorted result for the worksheet preview.
examples.zh: 练习表预览使用「OFFSET 跳行子句」跳过排序结果的前十条记录。

examples.en: We used a separate OFFSET clause when comparing the first and second pages of example data.
examples.zh: 比较示例数据第一页和第二页时，我们使用不同值的「OFFSET 跳行子句」。

collocations: set the number in an OFFSET clause
apply an OFFSET clause after sorting

words.enDefinition: a function that computes one result from a set of input rows, such as a sum or average

examples.en: The aggregate function calculated each week's total bookings from all the corresponding records in the activity table.
examples.zh: 「聚合函数」汇总活动表中相应的记录，算出每周预订总数。

examples.en: We chose an aggregate function that counted recorded scores and skipped any missing values in the gradebook.
examples.zh: 我们选择了一个「聚合函数」，统计已记录分数的条数，跳过缺失值。

collocations: compute a total with an aggregate function
check how an aggregate function handles nulls

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause that groups input rows by selected expressions for further calculation

examples.en: The GROUP BY clause gathered the sales rows by month before the query calculated each monthly total.
examples.zh: 查询计算各月合计之前，「GROUP BY 分组子句」先把销售记录按月归组。

examples.en: We changed the GROUP BY clause to show separate totals for each workshop location and date.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「GROUP BY 分组子句」，让各工作坊按地点及日期分别显示合计。

collocations: group rows with a GROUP BY clause
add an expression to the GROUP BY clause

words.enDefinition: the SQL clause filtering groups according to a specified condition after grouping

examples.en: The HAVING clause excluded locations whose total number of workshop bookings was below the chosen minimum.
examples.zh: 「HAVING 分组筛选子句」排除了工作坊预订数低于所选下限的地点。

examples.en: We used a HAVING clause to return only product categories with at least three different items.
examples.zh: 我们用「HAVING 分组筛选子句」只返回至少有三种商品的产品类别。

collocations: filter grouped results with a HAVING clause
include an aggregate condition in the HAVING clause

words.enDefinition: a column used to determine which rows are grouped together in a query

examples.en: We added a second grouping column to keep totals for different years separate in the report.
examples.zh: 我们加了第二个「分组列」，让报表里的不同年份各自计算合计。

examples.en: The tutor checked whether the grouping column represented a room name or a stable room identifier.
examples.zh: 导师核对了「分组列」记录的是房间名称，还是保持不变的房间标识符。

collocations: calculate totals by a grouping column

words.enDefinition: a SQL aggregate operation that counts distinct non-null values of a specified expression

examples.en: The tutor used COUNT DISTINCT to count how many different rooms appeared in the weekly bookings.
examples.zh: 导师用「去重计数」统计本周预订里出现了多少个不同房间。

examples.en: We compared COUNT DISTINCT with a count of all registration rows in the sample course dataset.
examples.zh: 我们把「去重计数」与样本课程数据中全部登记行的计数作了比较。

collocations: calculate a total with COUNT DISTINCT
use COUNT DISTINCT on a column
compare COUNT DISTINCT with a row count

words.enDefinition: the part of a database language used to create or change the definitions of database objects

examples.en: The class used data definition language to describe two tables before loading any of the sample records.
examples.zh: 同学们先用「数据定义语言」定义两张表，然后才载入示例记录。

examples.en: We read the data definition language commands to find where the table's primary key had been declared.
examples.zh: 我们阅读「数据定义语言」命令，找出在哪里声明了该表的主键。

collocations: use data definition language to create tables
execute a data definition language command

words.enDefinition: the part of a database language used to retrieve or change stored data, with scope varying by convention

examples.en: The workbook introduced data manipulation language by adding a new booking and correcting an existing classroom record.
examples.zh: 练习册通过新增一条预订和更正一条现有教室记录介绍「数据操作语言」。

examples.en: We used data manipulation language to update the class roster without changing the definitions of its columns.
examples.zh: 我们用「数据操作语言」更新班级名册，保持各列的定义。

collocations: write a data manipulation language command
use data manipulation language to update rows

words.enDefinition: a SQL function computing a value for each row using related rows in its window

examples.en: A window function added each booking's position in the schedule without collapsing the rows into one total.
examples.zh: 「窗口函数」为各条预订添加了它在日程中的位置，并保留了每条原始记录。

examples.en: We used a window function to display the current sales amount next to the previous month's amount.
examples.zh: 我们用「窗口函数」把本月销售额显示在上月金额旁边。

collocations: define a window for a window function
compute a running total with a window function

words.enDefinition: a group of query rows processed separately by a window function according to its partition expressions

examples.en: The window partition contained the monthly records for a single store in the sample reporting query.
examples.zh: 在示例报表查询中，「窗口分区」包含同一家门店的各月记录。

examples.en: We changed the window partition so the ranking would restart whenever the product category changed.
examples.zh: 我们修改了「窗口分区」，使每换一个产品类别就重新排名。

collocations: rank rows within a window partition
compute an average for each window partition

words.enDefinition: the subset of rows in a window partition made available relative to the current row for frame-sensitive calculations

examples.en: The window frame included the current week and the two preceding weeks for each average we calculated.
examples.zh: 我们计算各次平均值时，「窗口帧」包含本周及前两周的数据。

examples.en: The tutor shortened the window frame to show why the early rows had fewer values to average.
examples.zh: 导师缩短「窗口帧」，说明为什么前几行能用于计算平均值的数据较少。

collocations: calculate a total over a window frame

words.enDefinition: the order in which rows within each partition are considered for a window calculation

examples.en: We set the window ordering by date before calculating the change from each workshop's previous attendance record.
examples.zh: 计算工作坊每次出勤人数相对上次的变化前，我们按日期设置「窗口内排序」。

examples.en: The tutor distinguished window ordering from sorting the rows finally displayed in the example report.
examples.zh: 导师区分了「窗口内排序」和对示例报告最终显示的行排序。

collocations: check for ties in the window ordering

words.enDefinition: a SQL window function numbering partition rows consecutively, following any specified window order

examples.en: We used the ROW_NUMBER function to give each classroom booking a separate position in the displayed schedule.
examples.zh: 我们用「行号函数」给显示的日程里各条教室预订分配不同的位置编号。

examples.en: The ROW_NUMBER function started at one for each product category after we changed the partitioning expression.
examples.zh: 我们修改分区表达式后，「行号函数」在各个产品类别内都从一开始编号。

collocations: partition rows for the ROW_NUMBER function
add a tie breaker for the ROW_NUMBER function

words.zhGloss: 并列后跳号的排名函数
words.enDefinition: a SQL window function assigning tied rows the same rank and leaving gaps after ties
acceptedZhAnswers: 并列后跳号的排名函数

examples.en: The RANK function gave two rows first place and the following row third place in the example.
examples.zh: 示例中的「并列后跳号的排名函数」给两行并列第一，把下一行排为第三。

examples.en: Our tutor used the RANK function to show how equal scores affected the next position in the list.
examples.zh: 导师用「并列后跳号的排名函数」说明相同分数怎样影响列表的下一个名次。

collocations: sort scores for the RANK function
handle ties using the RANK function

words.zhGloss: 并列后不跳号的排名函数
words.enDefinition: a SQL window function assigning shared ranks to ties without leaving gaps in subsequent ranks
acceptedZhAnswers: 并列后不跳号的排名函数

examples.en: The DENSE_RANK function gave both top scores rank one and the next distinct score rank two.
examples.zh: 「并列后不跳号的排名函数」把两个最高分都排为第一，把下一个不同的分数排为第二。

examples.en: We used the DENSE_RANK function to display consecutive ranks for each distinct completion time in the exercise.
examples.zh: 我们用「并列后不跳号的排名函数」给练习中各个不同的完成时间显示连续名次。

collocations: rank distinct values with the DENSE_RANK function
compare the DENSE_RANK function with RANK

words.enDefinition: a sum reflecting the current value and preceding values in a specified order

examples.en: The query calculated a running total of reservations after arranging the records by their creation dates.
examples.zh: 查询按创建日期排列记录后，计算了预订条数的「累计合计」。

examples.en: We checked the running total after filtering out the cancelled bookings in our practice data.
examples.zh: 筛去练习数据里已取消的预订记录后，我们核对了「累计合计」。

collocations: reset a running total at a group boundary

words.enDefinition: the condition used to determine whether a pair of source rows qualifies as a match

examples.en: The join condition required the room number and building code to agree between the two source records.
examples.zh: 「联接条件」要求两条源记录的房间号和楼宇代码都吻合。

examples.en: We moved one filter into the join condition to keep all rows from the preserved side.
examples.zh: 我们把一个筛选条件移入「联接条件」，以保留指定一侧的所有行。

collocations: add a predicate to a join condition

words.enDefinition: a column or expression used to compare records from different inputs in a join

examples.en: The tutor chose the catalogue identifier as the join key because the title was sometimes entered differently.
examples.zh: 标题有时有不同写法，所以导师选目录标识符作「联接键」。

examples.en: We compared the field types on both sides of the join key before running the exercise query.
examples.zh: 运行练习查询前，我们比较了「联接键」两侧的字段类型。

collocations: compare values on a join key

words.enDefinition: a join returning combinations of input rows that match the join condition

examples.en: The inner join returned only catalogue entries that had at least one recorded loan in the sample.
examples.zh: 「内联接」只返回样本中至少存在一条借阅记录的目录条目。

examples.en: We used an inner join to show each order alongside the matching record for its supplier.
examples.zh: 我们用「内联接」把各条订单和对应的供应商记录并列显示。

collocations: join two tables with an inner join

words.enDefinition: a join retaining every left row and supplying nulls on the right when no right row matches

examples.en: The left outer join kept books with no recorded loans so they still appeared in the catalogue report.
examples.zh: 「左外联接」保留了没有借阅记录的书，因此它们仍出现在目录报告里。

examples.en: We changed the query to a left outer join before checking which classrooms had no reservations.
examples.zh: 我们先把查询改为「左外联接」，再检查哪些教室没有预订记录。

collocations: inspect unmatched rows from a left outer join

words.enDefinition: a join retaining every right row and supplying nulls on the left when no left row matches

examples.en: The right outer join retained rooms in the second table even when the first table held no bookings.
examples.zh: 即使第一张表没有相应预订，「右外联接」也保留第二张表里的房间。

examples.en: We rewrote the right outer join with the inputs swapped to demonstrate the equivalent left join.
examples.zh: 我们交换输入表后重写「右外联接」，以演示等价的左联接。

collocations: rewrite a right outer join as a left join

words.enDefinition: a join retaining matching row pairs and also unmatched rows from either side, padded with nulls as needed

examples.en: The full outer join showed matched catalogue codes and entries found in just one list.
examples.zh: 「全外联接」显示匹配的目录编码，以及只出现在一份清单中的条目。

examples.en: We used a full outer join to compare two class rosters compiled by different systems in the example.
examples.zh: 在示例中，我们用「全外联接」比较由两个不同系统生成的两份班级名册。

collocations: compare unmatched rows from a full outer join
reconcile lists using a full outer join

words.enDefinition: a join pairing each row of one input with every row of the other input

examples.en: The cross join paired each study room with every time slot when generating the blank timetable.
examples.zh: 生成空白日程表时，「交叉联接」把每间自习室与所有时段逐一组合起来。

examples.en: We predicted the number of rows produced by the cross join before running the classroom query.
examples.zh: 运行课堂查询前，我们预测了这次「交叉联接」会产生多少行。

collocations: count rows produced by a cross join
generate combinations with a cross join

words.enDefinition: a join in which two references to the same table serve as separate inputs

examples.en: We used a self join to find pairs of catalogue items that had the same publication year.
examples.zh: 我们用「自联接」查找出版年份相同的目录条目对。

examples.en: The tutor assigned a different alias to each table reference in the self join for the sample timetable.
examples.zh: 导师给示例日程查询「自联接」中的各处表引用分别分配了不同的别名。

collocations: alias inputs to a self join
compare rows with a self join

words.enDefinition: a join that matches rows using equality between the relevant values

examples.en: The equi-join compared each loan's catalogue code with the matching code in the table of books.
examples.zh: 「等值联接」将每条借阅记录的目录编码与图书表中的对应编码比较。

examples.en: We used an equi-join because the matching rule required exact agreement between the two workshop identifiers.
examples.zh: 因为匹配规则要求两个工作坊标识符完全一致，我们使用了「等值联接」。

collocations: compare an equi-join with a range join

words.enDefinition: an operation returning rows of one input for which no matching row exists in the other input

examples.en: The anti-join found all workshop dates that did not have any corresponding reservation in the practice table.
examples.zh: 「反联接」找到了练习表中没有任何对应预订记录的工作坊日期。

examples.en: We used an anti-join to identify catalogue entries that had never appeared in the sample borrowing records.
examples.zh: 我们用「反联接」找出未在示例借阅记录中出现过的目录条目。

collocations: express an anti-join with NOT EXISTS
find unmatched rows with an anti-join

words.enDefinition: an operation returning a row from one input if a match exists in the other, without repeating it for additional matches

examples.en: The semi-join listed each workshop with a booking once even when several groups had registered for it.
examples.zh: 「半联接」把每场有预订的工作坊列一次，即使已有多组完成报名。

examples.en: We used a semi-join to check which books appeared at least once in the sample loan table.
examples.zh: 我们用「半联接」检查哪些书至少在示例借阅表里出现过一次。

collocations: filter one input with a semi-join

words.enDefinition: a query appearing inside another SQL statement

examples.en: The subquery selected the events at the location specified before the outer query counted their bookings.
examples.zh: 外层查询对预订计数之前，「子查询」先选出指定地点举办的活动。

examples.en: We placed the subquery in the condition so the calculation could compare each class with the overall average.
examples.zh: 我们把「子查询」放进条件中，使计算能比较各班与总体平均值。

collocations: nest a subquery inside a statement

words.enDefinition: a subquery used in a scalar expression that returns at most one row with one column

examples.en: Our scalar subquery calculated the overall mean as a single value for comparison with each location's mean.
examples.zh: 我们的「标量子查询」计算一个总体平均值，供各地点的平均值与其比较。

examples.en: The tutor showed why returning two rows was invalid for the scalar subquery in the worksheet.
examples.zh: 导师说明了为什么返回两行在练习表的「标量子查询」中无效。

collocations: use a scalar subquery as an expression
check that a scalar subquery returns one column

words.enDefinition: a subquery containing a reference to a value supplied by an enclosing query scope

examples.en: The correlated subquery reused the room identifier from the outer query to count bookings for that room.
examples.zh: 「相关子查询」使用外层查询的房间标识符，统计该房间的预订记录。

examples.en: We identified the outer reference in the correlated subquery before explaining how its result depended on each row.
examples.zh: 我们在「相关子查询」中找出对外层的引用，再解释其结果如何依赖各行数据。

collocations: identify the outer reference in a correlated subquery

words.enDefinition: a SQL predicate true when its subquery returns at least one row

examples.en: The EXISTS predicate checked whether each room had any reservation in the timetable for the following week.
examples.zh: 「EXISTS 存在谓词」检查日程表上的各房间下周是否至少有一条预订记录。

examples.en: We negated the EXISTS predicate to return only products with no corresponding sale in the classroom data.
examples.zh: 我们对「EXISTS 存在谓词」取反，只返回课堂数据中没有对应销售记录的产品。

collocations: filter rows with an EXISTS predicate

words.enDefinition: a SQL predicate testing a value for membership in a list or a query result, with SQL null rules

examples.en: Our IN predicate selected bookings for any of the three rooms used in the class workshop.
examples.zh: 我们的「IN 成员谓词」选出课堂工作坊使用的三个房间中任一房间的预订。

examples.en: The tutor checked how the IN predicate behaved when the comparison list included a missing code.
examples.zh: 导师检查比较列表包含一个缺失代码时，「IN 成员谓词」会怎样求值。

collocations: combine an IN predicate with a subquery
check null handling in an IN predicate

words.enDefinition: a table expression produced by a subquery used as a row source within a query

examples.zh: 示意图在最后一项更改之后、课堂数据库连接关闭之前标出了「事务边界」。

examples.zh: 「事务提交」后，另一个会话在下一条读已提交查询中看到了我们更新的数据。
